description: Defines the 'Column' class used for report header columns in the OrangeHRM system, including properties like name, property identifier, pinning, size, and cell properties.

classes.name: Column
classes.description: Represents a report header column with properties such as name, property identifier, pinning, size, and cell properties, with methods to manipulate and serialize these properties.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a Column object with a specified property identifier.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the column.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the column.

methods.name: getProp
methods.description: Returns the property identifier of the column.

methods.name: setProp
methods.description: Sets the property identifier of the column.

methods.name: getPin
methods.description: Returns the pinning status of the column.

methods.name: setPin
methods.description: Sets the pinning status of the column, validating allowed values.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the column.

methods.name: setSize
methods.description: Sets the size of the column.

methods.name: getCellProperties
methods.description: Returns the cell properties of the column.

methods.name: setCellProperties
methods.description: Sets the cell properties of the column.

methods.name: addCellProperties
methods.description: Adds or replaces cell properties of the column.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Serializes the column properties into an associative array.
